active_pullup.docs:
**boolean**: Enable the active pullup feature. Useful for long lines or heavier bus loads. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x18`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) to use. Required if you have configured multiple I²C buses.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the 1-Wire bus. Required if you have configured multiple 1-Wire buses.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

bus_sleep.docs:
**boolean**: Put the 1-Wire bus to sleep when not in use. Only available for `ds2482-101` and `ds2484`. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

hub_sleep.docs:
**boolean**: Put the bridge chip to sleep when not in use. Requires `sleep_pin` and is only available for `ds2482-101` and `ds2484`. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

sleep_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: A GPIO pin connected to the `SLPZ` pin. Only available for `ds2482-101` and `ds2484`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

active_pullup.docs:
**boolean**: Enable the active pullup feature. Useful for long lines or heavier bus loads. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x18`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) to use. Required if you have configured multiple I²C buses.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the 1-Wire bus. Required if you have configured multiple 1-Wire buses.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

active_pullup_resistance.docs:
**string**: The active pullup resistance. One of `500ohm` or `1000ohm`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

master_sample_time.docs:
**int**: Adjust the master sample time (`tMSP`). Value from `0` to `15`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

recovery_time.docs:
**int**: Adjust the recovery time (`tREC0`). Value from `0` to `15`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

reset_low_time.docs:
**int**: Adjust the reset low time (`tRSTL`). Value from `0` to `15`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

write_0_low_time.docs:
**int**: Adjust the write-0 low time (`tW0L`). Value from `0` to `15`.

*See also: [DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/ds248x#configuration-variables)*

CONFIG_SCHEMA.docs: The DS248x chip variant. One of `ds2482-100`, `ds2482-101`, `ds2482-800`, or `ds2484`.
